Configuration¶

Widget reads its settings from widget.toml in the project root.

Options¶

timeout

Seconds before a request is abandoned. Defaults to 30.

retries

How many times to retry. Defaults to 3.

Example:

[widget]
timeout = 60
retries = 5

[widget.proxy]
    url = "http://proxy:3128"

Warning

Setting retries above 10 is rejected.
